signals.text: Drama is an expressive art form that provides students a platform to develop transferrable skills, such as language and communication skills, public speech, critical and creative thinking skills, teamwork, concentration, confidence, self- awareness, and empathy.
Students will be taught to listen to and analyse music from a wide range of genres, learning about tonality, tempo, time signatures, musical structures, and melodic, harmonic and rhythmic features.

We are committed to extending our offer here in Drama and therefore actively encourage students to participate in our drama club, school productions and seek opportunities for performances and trips with external providers to offer experiences beyond the school environment.
Computing The Computing Department at Prendergast Ladywell School aims to equip students with the skills to participate in a rapidly-changing world through challenging and engaging topics.
The confidence to perform music is given a great emphasize, small classroom performances happen from the start of year 7.

Welcome and Ethos
Headteacher's Message
Prendergast Ladywell School is a coeducational 4-16 school where young people in our local community are provided with an excellent education that enables them to achieve outstanding outcomes in a safe, supportive, and inclusive learning environment. We are a school that CARES; where Community, Ambition, Resilience, Effort, and Success are valued. Our students are led by reflective and committed teachers and support staff.
We believe that all our students can Achieve Excellence; it is the motto written on the badge of every student in the school. Prendergast Ladywell School provides high-quality teaching and an enjoyable and challenging curriculum, complemented by a wide range of enrichment activities. Our reflective and kind students are encouraged to make positive contributions to our school and our community, and to be healthy, happy, and engaged citizens.
Our school ethos is underpinned by the relationships that the members of our community have with each other. These relationships are built on the foundation of compassion, equity, and mutual respect, so that members of our community have a sense of belonging and are free to develop into the best versions of themselves.
We are Stronger Together; we contribute to and benefit from the collaboration and support of the Leathersellers' Federation Vision and Values
We look forward to working with you.
Niall Hand MA Headteacher
“It is only when you look back, that you realise how the changes which we have made are adding up to a real transformation in the school.”
“My son has a brilliant rapport with all the teachers at the school. This has definitely contributed to him achieving above his target grades.”
“My daughter has come on in leaps and bounds since transferring from her previous school.”
Prendergast Ladywell Okulu, öğrencilerin güvenli, destekleyici ve kapsayıcı bir eğitim ve öğrenim ortamında yüksek sonuçlar elde etmelerini sağlayan mükemmel bir eğitimle donatıldığı, 4-16 yaş arası karma bir okuldur. Biz, öğrencilerimizle yakından ilgilenen ve onlara özen gösteren bir okuluz; Okulumuz, hedefe odaklı, güçlü, çaba ve başarıya değer verilen bir yerdir. Öğrencilerimize iyi eğitimli profesyonel öğretmenler ve öğretmen asistanları eğitim ve öğretim verir.
Tüm öğrencilerimizin mükemmelliğe ulaşabileceğine inanıyoruz; okuldaki her öğrencinin yaka kartında yazan sloganımız budur. Prendergast Ladywell Okulu, yüksek kaliteli öğretim ve öğrencinin ilerleme kaydetmesini sağlayan eğlenceli ve titiz bir müfredat sunar. Düşünceli ve kibar öğrencilerimiz okulumuza olumlu katkılarda bulunmaya ve sağlıklı, mutlu ve sorumlu vatandaşlar olmaya teşvik edilir.
Okul etiğimiz, okuldaki herkesin birbirleriyle olan saygı ve sevgiye dayanan davranışlarla desteklenmektedir. Bu davranışlar şefkat, eşitlik ve karşılıklı saygı temelleri üzerine kuruludur, böylece okulumuzun her üyesi bir aidiyet duygusuna sahip olur ve kendilerini en iyi şekilde geliştirebilirler.
Birlikte Daha Güçlüyüz; Leatherseller’s Federasyonu'nun işbirliğine ve desteğine katkıda bulunuyor ve bundan yararlanıyoruz. Öğrencilerimiz Federasyon'da 16 yaş üzeri eğitime de hak kazanıyorlar.
Niall Hand Headteacher
Prendergast Ladywell School este o unitate de invatamant mixta pentru elevi cu varsta intre 4 – 16 ani, in care tinerii din comunitatea noastra primesc o educatie excelenta care ii sustine in a obtine rezultate extraordinare intr-un mediu de invatare sigur, sustinator si incluziv. Suntem o scoala careia II PASA; in care Comunitatea, Ambitia, Rezilienta, Efortul si Succesul sunt apreciate. Elevii nostri sunt indrumati de profesori bine pregatiti si de personal auxiliar profesional.
Noi credem ca toti elevii nostri pot atinge excelenta; acesta este motto-ul scris pe insigna fiecarui elev din scoala. Prendegast Ladywell School ofera invatamant de calitate si o programa placuta si plina de provocari care permite elevilor sa faca progrese; oferim o serie de activitati de dezvoltare personala. Elevii nostri buni si chibzuiti sunt incurajati sa contribuie in mod pozitiv la scoala si comunitatea noastra si sa fie cetateni sanatosi, fericiti si implicati.
Etosul scolii noastre este sprijinit de relatiile pe care membri comunitatii noastre le au unii cu ceilalti. Aceste relatii se bazeaza pe compasiune, corectitudine si respect reciproc, asa incat fiecare membru are sentimentul ca apartine comunitatii si este liber sa se dezvolte cat mai tare.
Suntem mai Puternici Impreuna; contribuim si beneficiem de colaborarea si sprijinul Federatiei Scolare Leathersellers. Elevii nostri au dreptul sa beneficieze de oferta scolara de dupa 16 ani din cadrul Federatiei.
Niall Hand Headteacher
La escuela Prendergast Ladywell es una escuela mixta de 4 a 16 años donde los jóvenes de nuestra comunidad local reciben una educación excelente que les permite lograr resultados sobresalientes en un entorno de aprendizaje seguro, de apoyo e inclusivo. Somos una escuela que SE PREOCUPA; donde se valora la comunidad, la ambición, la resiliencia, el esfuerzo y el éxito. Nuestros estudiantes son dirigidos por maestros bien capacitados y personal de apoyo profesional.
Creemos que todos nuestros estudiantes pueden lograr la excelencia; es la moto escrita en la placa de cada estudiante de la escuela. La escuela Prendergast Ladywell ofrece enseñanza de alta calidad y un plan de estudios divertido y desafiante que permite a los estudiantes progresar; Ofrecemos una variedad de actividades de enriquecimiento. Se anima a nuestros estudiantes reflexivos y amables a hacer contribuciones positivas a nuestra escuela, nuestra comunidad y a ser ciudadanos saludables, felices y comprometidos.
Nuestro espíritu escolar se sustenta en las relaciones que los miembros de nuestra comunidad tienen entre sí. Estas relaciones se basan en la compasión, la equidad y el respeto mutuo, de modo que cada miembro de nuestra comunidad tenga un sentido de pertenencia y sea libre de convertirse en la mejor versión de sí mismo.
Somos más fuertes juntos; contribuimos y nos beneficiamos de la colaboración y el apoyo de la Federación de Escuelas. Nuestros estudiantes tienen derecho a la provisión Post 16 en la Federación.
Niall Hand Headteacher
A escola Prendergast Ladywell é uma escola mista de 4 a 16 anos, onde os jovens de nossa comunidade local recebem uma educação excelente que lhes permite alcançar resultados excepcionais em um ambiente de aprendizagem seguro, solidário e inclusivo. Somos uma escola que SE IMPORTA; onde Comunidade, Ambição, Resiliência, Esforço e Sucesso são valorizados. Nossos alunos são liderados por professores bem treinados e equipe de apoio profissional.
Acreditamos que todos os nossos alunos podem alcançar a excelência; é a moto escrita no crachá de cada aluno da escola. A escola Prendergast Ladywell oferece ensino de alta qualidade e um currículo agradável e desafiador que permite ao aluno progredir; nós fornecemos uma variedade de atividades de enriquecimento. Nossos alunos reflexivos e gentis são incentivados a fazer contribuições positivas para nossa escola, nossa comunidade e a serem cidadãos saudáveis, felizes e engajados.
Nosso ethos escolar é sustentado pelas relações que os membros de nossa comunidade têm uns com os outros. Essas relações são construídas sobre as bases da compaixão, equidade e respeito mútuo, de modo que cada membro de nossa comunidade tenha um sentimento de pertença e seja livre para se desenvolver nas melhores versões de si mesmo.
Somos mais fortes juntos; nós contribuímos e nos beneficiamos da colaboração e apoio da Federação de Escolas Leathersellers. Nossos alunos têm direito à provisão do Posto 16 na Federação.
Niall Hand Headteacher
Prendergast Ladywell School est une école mixte pour les élèves d’âge 4 à 16 ans où les jeunes de notre communauté locale reçoivent une excellente formation scolaire qui leur permet d'obtenir des résultats exceptionnels dans un environnement d'apprentissage sûr, encourageant et inclusif. Nous sommes une école qui accord de l’importance aux principes de CARES; où la communauté, l'ambition, la résilience, l'effort et le succès sont estimés. Nos étudiants sont enseignés par des professeurs bien formés et un personnel de soutien professionnel.
Nous croyons que tous nos étudiants peuvent atteindre l'excellence ; c'est la devise inscrite sur l'insigne de chaque élève de l'école. Prendergast Ladywell School offre un enseignement de haute qualité et un programme scolaire agréable et stimulant qui permet aux étudiants de développer ; nous proposons une gamme d'activités d'enrichissement. Nos élèves réfléchis et gentils sont encouragés de contribuer d’une manière positive à notre école et à notre communauté, tout en étant des citoyens en bonne santé, heureux et engagés.
Notre éthique de l'école est renforcé par les relations que les membres de notre communauté entretiennent les uns avec les autres. Ces relations reposent sur les fondements de la compassion, de l'équité et du respect mutuel, afin que chaque membre de notre communauté ait un sentiment d'appartenance et soit libre de se développer et devenir la meilleure version d’eux-mêmes.
Nous sommes plus forts ensemble ; nous contribuons et bénéficions de la collaboration et du soutien de la Fédération des Écoles des Leathersellers. Nos étudiants ont droit à la formation Post-16 dans la Fédération.
Niall Hand Directeur d’école
مدرسة بريندرغاست ليدي ويل هي مدرسة تعليمية مشتركة من 4 إلى 16 حيث يتم تزويد الشباب في مجتمعنا المحلي بتعليم ممتاز يمكنهم من تحقيق نتائج متميزة في بيئة تعليمية آمنة وداعمة وشاملة. نحن مدرسة تهتم؛ حيث يتم تقدير المجتمع والطموح والمرونة والجهد والنجاح. ويقود طلابنا من قبل المعلمين العاكسة وملتزمة وموظفي الدعم.
نحن نؤمن بأن جميع طلابنا يمكنهم تحقيق التميز؛ إنه الشعار المكتوب على شارة كل طالب في المدرسة. تقدم مدرسة بريندرغاست ليدي ويل تدريسا عالي الجودة ومناهج تعليمية ممتعة وصعبة، تكملها مجموعة واسعة من أنشطة الإثراء. يتم تشجيع طلابنا العاكسين والطيبين على تقديم مساهمات إيجابية لمدرستنا ومجتمعنا ، وأن يكونوا مواطنين أصحاء وسعداء ومنخرطين.
ترتكز روح مدرستنا على العلاقات التي تربط أعضاء مجتمعنا ببعضهم البعض. هذه العلاقات مبنية على أساس الرحمة والإنصاف والاحترام المتبادل بحيث يكون لدى أفراد مجتمعنا شعور بالانتماء وأحرار في التطور إلى أفضل الإصدارات من أنفسهم.
نحن أقوى معا؛ ونحن نساهم ونستفيد من التعاون والدعم من اتحاد مدارس Leathersellers
ونحن نتطلع إلى العمل معكم.
نيال هاند مدير المدرسة

Welcome and Ethos
Headteacher's Message
Prendergast Ladywell School is a coeducational 4-16 school where young people in our local community are provided with an excellent education that enables them to achieve outstanding outcomes in a safe, supportive, and inclusive learning environment. We are a school that CARES; where Community, Ambition, Resilience, Effort, and Success are valued. Our students are led by reflective and committed teachers and support staff.
We believe that all our students can Achieve Excellence; it is the motto written on the badge of every student in the school. Prendergast Ladywell School provides high-quality teaching and an enjoyable and challenging curriculum, complemented by a wide range of enrichment activities. Our reflective and kind students are encouraged to make positive contributions to our school and our community, and to be healthy, happy, and engaged citizens.
Our school ethos is underpinned by the relationships that the members of our community have with each other. These relationships are built on the foundation of compassion, equity, and mutual respect, so that members of our community have a sense of belonging and are free to develop into the best versions of themselves.
We are Stronger Together; we contribute to and benefit from the collaboration and support of the Leathersellers' Federation Vision and Values
We look forward to working with you.

Music
Music at Prendergast Ladywell is broad, diverse and ambitious. Skills and knowledge are at the forefront of everything we do. We focus on skills relevant to music performance, creativity skills for improvisation and music composition, and music listening skills to identify and analyse musical elements.
Students will learn about different periods of musical history and music from many different cultures. They’ll listen to and perform music from Western classical traditions, popular music traditions and world music traditions.
The confidence to perform music is given a great emphasize, small classroom performances happen from the start of year 7. Students will develop confidence, collaboration, resilience, teamwork by performing as small groups as well as developing skills on various instruments including keyboards, ukuleles, percussion, and voice.
Students will be taught to listen to and analyse music from a wide range of genres, learning about tonality, tempo, time signatures, musical structures, and melodic, harmonic and rhythmic features.
Examination Board: Pearson Edexcel

Drama
The Drama curriculum has a vital role to play in the development of the young people we serve here at Prendergast Ladywell School. We are keen to develop the whole child by enabling them to explore a broad range of themes and social issues in a safe and stimulating environment. Drama supports students in becoming self-regulating individuals who can access learning and the world in an imaginative and creative way.
Drama is an expressive art form that provides students a platform to develop transferrable skills, such as language and communication skills, public speech, critical and creative thinking skills, teamwork, concentration, confidence, self- awareness, and empathy.
Our curriculum is diverse in its content covering a multitude of content such as: Physical theatre, Greek theatre, Commedia Del’ Arte, Pantomime, Epic theatre. It also explores a variety of modern practitioners and work including: Berkoff, Brecht, Arturd, Le Coq and Stanislavski.
Beyond this we aim to empower students to create art with a social message and we cover a wide variety of social moral spiritual and cultural material through our devising units which explore immigration, racism, social inequality and much more. Drama promotes self-esteem, every learning episode is an opportunity for pupils to feel a sense of accomplishment regardless of academic ability.
All lessons are delivered in one of two Drama Studios, one of which is purpose built with specialist equipment, offering students a professional space to work in. We are committed to extending our offer here in Drama and therefore actively encourage students to participate in our drama club, school productions and seek opportunities for performances and trips with external providers to offer experiences beyond the school environment.
Examinations Board: Pearson Edexcel

History
The History curriculum at PLS is broad ranging, with a combination of breadth and depth studies as well as examining both Kings, Queens and Wars and the lives of ordinary people. The curriculum is designed to prepare students for GCSE study as well as giving all a grounding in the foundational skills and knowledge of the discipline. The subject is taught chronologically, with regular thematic studies reinforcing understanding of chronology and how historians divide time into periods. The course clearly covers aspects of history that are relevant to many of our students and demonstrates diversity rather than focusing solely on white British history.
Currently, students are delivered one hour a week of Geography in Year 7 and Year 8, and two hours in Year 9. Each termly module has a main topic focus, with occasional single lesson focus on a specific source in order to secure understanding of this important historical concept.

Lessons follow the Hodder Understanding History book and associated scheme of work / lesson plans, as these provide for a broad, balanced and ambitious curriculum.

Citizenship
The principal aim of Citizenship Studies at Prendergast Ladywell is to engage pupils in the local and global world; to consider their role as global citizens and to think both critically and proactively about politicised environments. The course encourages students to play an active part in public and democratic life as informed and active citizens. There are four themes: Living together in the UK, Democracy at work in the UK, Law and Justice and Power and influence - The UK’s relationship with the rest of the world.
Further to knowledge-based learning, students learn the skills to become active citizens so that they can engage with topics close to their hearts and interests. They will be required to design and run a campaign of their own where they will develop skills in research and investigation, problem solving, advocacy and campaigning.
Discussion is key to Citizenship Studies. We reflect on current issues (for example COP26, Afghanistan in crisis), current questions and debates. Students develop knowledge and understanding of the role of citizenship in relation to political and democratic issues and discourse that impacts modern society.

Art
The Art and Design curriculum at Prendergast Ladywell School complements the broad and well-balanced whole school provision for our students. It provides a wide range of opportunities designed to extend and develop skills and knowledge, allowing individual expression of thoughts and ideas. The curriculum encourages individuality but also develops a sense of teamwork and mutual respect.
We provide an inspiring and challenging curriculum with practical elements which focus on developing transferable skills aiming to develop resilient, confident, and creative thinkers with an empathic understanding of our place in the world.
Our art curriculum uses subject specific vocabulary to encourage discussion and debate on key issues, promoting curiosity and critical engagement by challenging preconceptions, using both historical and contemporary references to develop a wider understanding of the power of art and design in society.
Our curriculum is designed to reflect our diverse community through an inclusive approach to content, giving individuals the confidence to succeed and the resilience to aspire, and to inspire others.

English
The English curriculum is centred around developing competent and confident communicators who leave with strong examination results in English Language and English Literature.
The English department promotes the habit of reading widely and often, covering a broad range of diverse and challenging fiction and non-fiction texts​, to create life-long readers for both pleasure and information. Students learn to be equipped to independently analyse and critically interpret a range of texts across genres and forms. Students gain a deep knowledge and understanding of relevant social, historical, biographical and literary contexts and how they influence the construction and reception of texts.
Our curriculum provides many opportunities for extended writing on a wide range of challenging topics for a variety of genres and forms​. We encourage creativity when writing to express ideas, opinions and feelings with clarity and accuracy.
Oracy and self-expression are integral to our curriculum and promote critical thinking to allow students to articulate their own viewpoints whilst engaging sensitively with the perspectives of others.
We are committed to equipping all our students with the skills needed to pursue careers that require a high proficiency in English.

The curriculum is designed to prepare students for GCSE study as well as giving all a grounding in the foundational skills and knowledge of the discipline. The subject is taught as a topic-based system, which enables students to develop a strong foundation of geographical skills including cartographic, numerical, and graphical skills. Students develop a knowledge of both local Geography, including London and the UK as well as other countries in the world, e.g., China.
Currently, students are delivered one hour a week of Geography in Year 7 and Year 8, and two hours in Year 9. Each termly module has a main topic focus, with an occasional single lesson emphasis on a specific geographical skill, in order to secure understanding of that skill. Students are taught a series of different topics, to prepare them for their GCSE examinations. In addition, students are also required to experience a range of fieldwork and the skills that underpin this. Recent fieldwork locations have included The Olympic Park at Stratford and the North Kent coast at Reculver.

Design and Technology
The Design Technology department aims to create a stimulating learning environment where young people have the opportunity to learn about materials, processes and new technology through designing and making a range of different products, exploring the work of existing designers and analysing existing products and systems.
Design Technology is an inspiring, rigorous, and practical subject, which prepares young people to live and contribute to the world around us. Sustainability is a strong theme throughout our curriculum – analysis of how products and materials impact the environment and what can be done is an ongoing issue that is addressed in the classroom and through directed independent study at home.
Students experience a range of materials such as polymers, timbers and papers/boards; learning both traditional and hi-tech ways of manufacturing quality products from these materials. Students also study core technical principles and are able to apply their scientific and mathematical knowledge within real life technological contexts.
The department is committed to ensuring all students learn in a safe, inspiring environment giving equal access to all students and celebrating cultural diversity.

Business
An engaging and inspiring curriculum that reflects the demands of a truly modern and evolving business environment, that will develop an appreciation of moral and ethical issues relating to the operations of a business.
This qualification is ideal for students desiring to pursue pathways into A-Level Business, A-Level Economics and OCR Cambridge Technicals Level 3 in Business. It is also ideal for students wishing to undertake apprenticeships.
Through effective planning and teaching, we consider that all our students learn in a variety of ways. We aim to meet the needs of all our students as individuals, scaffolding exam questions to help aid and develop exam technique. Students will carry out group and independent learning tasks, focusing on researching real-life businesses and creating case studies around business topics. Students will investigate past and present successes and failures of businesses, gaining wider knowledge to apply to exam questions. Students will also learn how to work independently on the coursework elements, managing their time to create designs and proposals as well as developing their communication skills.
This qualification is for learners aged 14-16 who wish to develop applied knowledge and practical skills in enterprise and marketing. It is designed with both practical and theoretical elements, which will prepare students for further study of qualifications in enterprise, marketing, or business. For example, learners may progress onto OCR’s Level 3 Certificate in Preparing for a Business Venture, OCR’s Level 3 Cambridge Technical in Business, Introductory Certificates in Marketing or A Levels in related subjects.
All learners will study three mandatory topics as follows:
• Enterprise and marketing concepts
• Design a business proposal
• Market and pitch a business proposal
The first topic underpins the wider learning in this qualification. Learners will develop essential knowledge and understanding of enterprise and marketing concepts, which can be applied to the other units within the qualification. Through the first topic learners will understand the main activities that will need to happen to support a start-up business, and what the key factors are to consider when starting up a business.
In the second topic, learners will develop the skills to design a business proposal to meet a specific business challenge. They will identify a customer profile for a specific product, complete market research to generate product design ideas, and use financial calculations to propose a pricing strategy and determine the viability of their product proposal. The knowledge and skills developed by completing this unit will assist learners in the third topic of this qualification.
In the third topic, learners will develop the skills to create a brand identity and promotional plan for their specific business product proposal developed in the second topic. They will develop pitching skills to pitch their business proposal to an external audience. Finally, they will review their pitching skills and business proposal using their learning, self-assessment and feedback gathered. The knowledge and skills developed by completing this topic will be transferable to further, related learning in areas such as enterprise, marketing, or business.
